description: Component-scoped token overrides for the button primitive's real variants observed across homepage and landing pages.

default-expanding.behavior: widens 152px->240px on hover via spring, label translates up out of box
default-expanding.usage: landing hero CTAs, sticky bar CTA

cta-primary-3d.hoverBehavior: shadow alpha falls to 0, content moves down ~5px and scaleY .898 then springs back
cta-primary-3d.usage: case-banner CTA, video-wall CTAs on agency/tryvalley/automation
